simple.meaning: נְקָמָה (nᵉqâmâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “avengement , whether the act or the passion.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: נְקָמָה (H5360) appears 27 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Numbers 31:2, with occurrences in Numbers, Judges, 2 Samuel, Psalms, Jeremiah, and 2 more.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נְקָמָה (H5360) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in נְקָמָה (H5360) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: נְקָמָה (nᵉqâmâh) / H5360 is traced through Numbers 31:2, Numbers 31:3, Judges 11:36, 2 Samuel 4:8 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: avengement , whether the act or the passion
definitions.full: H5360. neqamah נְקָמָה noun feminine vengeance (on formation compare Lag BN 143 ); — ׳נ Jer 46:10 3 t.; construct נִקְמַת Num 31:2 7 t.; suffix נִקְמָתִי Ezek 25:14 7 t. suffixes; plural נְקָמוֺת Judg 11:36 5 t.; נְקָמֹת 2Sam 22:48 ; — 1 vengeance of God, absolute Ezek 25:14 ; נ ׳נקם Jer 51:36 ; נִקְמַת דַּם Psa 79:10 ; נְקָמוֺת אֵל 94:1 (twice in verse); נ ׳עֵת Jer 51:6 ; נ ׳יוֺם 46:10 ; ׳נ יהוה 50:15 , 28 ; 51:11 ; ׳נ הֵיכָלוֺ 50:28 ; 51:11 ; with בְּ of adversary, נ ׳נתן Ezek 25:14 , 17 ; נ ׳עשׂה 25:17 ; with מִן of adversary נ ׳נתן 2Sam 4:8 נ ׳עשׂה Judg 11:36 ; מֵהֶם נִקְמָֽתְךָ Jer 11:20 ; 20:12 ; with לְ whom נ ׳נתן 2Sam 22:48 = Psa 18:48 . 2 of Israel and its chiefs נ ׳נקם מן Num 31:2 (P); with ני ׳נתן ׳בְ, 31:3 (P); נ ׳עשׂה Psa 149:7 . 3 enemies of Israel absolute Lam 3:60 ; בנקמה עשׂה ; Ezek 25:15 ; of Jeremiah מ ׳לקח מן Jer 20:10 .
